summary: Wall Rose may be breached. Mike's squad meets a Titan that is not mindless, and the 104th is scattered through the villages inside the wall.

segments.ja: ウォール・ローゼの内側に、巨人がいる、という報せが調査兵団へ届きます。穴の位置はまだ特定できません。特定できないまま、南方の村が前線になります。エレンは壁の上の秘密を抱えたまま、この新しい警報を聞きます。司祭ニックが黙っている事実と、壁の中に敵が入った事実は、同じ日に重なります。重なった日は、まだ一つの説明を持っていません。説明が無い警報は、兵士の足だけを先に動かします。
segments.en: Word reaches the Survey Corps that Titans are inside Wall Rose. The place of the hole is not known yet. While it stays unknown, the southern villages become the front. Eren hears this new alarm while he is still holding the secret from the top of the wall. The fact that Pastor Nick stays silent and the fact that an enemy has entered the wall land on the same day. The day they share does not yet have one explanation. An alarm without an explanation moves the soldiers' feet first.

segments.ja: ハンジはニックに、壁の中で見たものを言葉にするよう求めます。司祭は信仰を盾にして、詳細を出しません。エルヴィンはその盾を、今日は割りません。割る時間より、ウォール・ローゼの突破を止める時間のほうが短いからです。ニックの沈黙は、秘密がまだ生きている証拠です。証拠は、村を守りません。守るのは馬に乗った兵士です。馬の数は、村の数より少ないです。
segments.en: Hange asks Nick to put into words what he saw inside the wall. The priest uses faith as a shield and does not give the details. Erwin does not break that shield today. There is less time to stop a breach of Wall Rose than there is to break a silence. Nick's silence is proof that the secret is still alive. The proof does not protect a village. Soldiers on horses do. There are fewer horses than villages.

segments.ja: ミケは分隊長として、巨人の気配を鼻で分ける兵士です。今日の気配は、今までのどの匂いとも少し違います。違うことを、彼はすぐには報告の文にしません。馬を進め、村の方向を確認し、部下の位置を数えます。数は足りています。足りていることが、安心にはなりません。獣のような影が、通常の巨人の列から外れています。外れ方が、空腹の動きではありません。空腹でない動きは、分隊長の経験の外にあります。
segments.en: Mike, as squad leader, is a soldier who sorts Titans by smell. Today's presence is a little different from every smell so far. He does not turn the difference into a report at once. He moves the horses, checks the direction of the villages, and counts his people. The count is enough. Enough is not comfort. A beast-like shadow has left the line of ordinary Titans. The way it left is not the movement of hunger. Movement that is not hunger sits outside the squad leader's experience.

segments.ja: 獣の巨人は、壁の外から来た怪物の一種としては片づきません。背が高く、歩き方が人間の作戦に似て、周囲の巨人を道具のように扱います。ミケはそれを奇行種という言葉で呼びたかったはずです。言葉が追いつきません。追いつかない相手は、調査兵団の図にまだ枠がありません。枠がない敵を、分隊長は自分の隊だけで受け止めます。受け止める場所は、村と村のあいだの野です。野には、隠れる壁がありません。
segments.en: The Beast Titan cannot be filed as one more kind of monster from outside the walls. It is tall, its walk resembles a human plan, and it handles the Titans around it like tools. Mike would have wanted to call it an Abnormal. The word does not catch up. An opponent the word cannot catch has no frame on the Survey Corps' diagram yet. The squad leader receives that frameless enemy with his squad alone. The place of the receiving is the field between villages. In the field there is no wall to hide behind.

tokens.note: A Titan that is not mindless. It can speak, and it throws. A Titan with a beast's shape. It does not walk like the mindless ones.

segments.en: The first things to fall in the fight are horses, not soldiers. Without horses, on flat ground where ODM gear cannot reach, the way out gets narrow. In that narrow way Mike turns the Beast Titan's attention onto himself. Turning it is not an order. It is the squad leader's choice. During the choice, some of his people run the horseless road toward the villages. Mike watches their backs go. The watching becomes today's parting. The parting is not recorded as an order.

segments.en: The Beast Titan does not only roar. It puts human words out of a Titan's mouth. Mike hears those words as tactics. What he understands is that the opponent is not hunger. It is looking at their gear and their limits. After looking, it drops the squad leader in among the Titans. Even after the drop, Mike does not let go of the blade. segments.en: Connie and Sasha are posted near village work after training. The alarm cuts that ordinary day in one stroke. Inside the cut day, the two of them count horses, residents, and Titan footsteps at the same time. The counts do not match. The mismatch is evidence that the place of the breach is unknown. Holding that evidence, they head not for the wall but for where the people are. Faces of family are ahead of them. The direction of those faces is today's real map.

The Survey Corps splits soldiers south and sends a check to each village. Every time a check returns, the sentence that there is still no hole grows. The growing sentences are not comfort. segments.en: The word hometown did not point only at lost land outside the walls. The villages of Wall Rose are someone's hometown too. Titans are walking in that hometown. Soldiers try not to look at the direction of their own houses on the operation map. Even trying not to, the horses' path goes near those houses. segments.en: After the alarm, garrison soldiers and survey soldiers move south all at once. The column is long and the talk is short. Someone saw a Titan. Someone has not. There are not enough horses. A village is silent. A silent village cannot yet be judged as destroyed or as evacuated. The next squad checks the village that cannot be judged. Mike's name, which had been at the front of the check, becomes a small voice at the back of the column. The small voice spreads the squad leader's absence. That absence changes who leads the next squad.
